name: Yerba Mate
siboNotes: Plain yerba mate is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally FODMAP-free. Avoid sweetened versions or additives that may contain FODMAPs.
preparationTips: Brew with hot (not boiling) water to reduce bitterness
Start with shorter steeping times if new to yerba mate
Avoid adding honey, agave, or other high-FODMAP sweeteners
Can be enjoyed hot or cold without affecting FODMAP content
nutritionalHighlights: Contains caffeine for natural energy boost
Good source of vitamins A, C, and E
Provides minerals including potassium and magnesium
